end.summary:
Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Distinguished straight lines from curved lines using shape and direction.
Identified line types in V, T, H, A, L and a goal.
Teach-back was not completed; 5 of 6 line-identification attempts were unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the line types by connecting them to letters and familiar objects. Om explained that curved lines go around while straight lines can be slanting, and identified lines in several examples. They briefly mixed up a standing line falling over with becoming a sleeping line; this was not revisited before the lesson ended. At home, invite Om to find one example of each line type in the room and name it.
